description: List fixed assets on the register with cost, net book value, monthly depreciation and status. Use when the user asks about their asset register, depreciation schedules, NBV, or capital items tracked per asset. Filter by active, disposed, or all.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

status.description: Filter by asset status. Defaults to active.

name: get_fixed_assets
title: Get Fixed Assets
